_comment_models: OpenAI models: gpt-5-nano (fastest/cheapest), gpt-5-mini (balanced), gpt-5.2 (most capable). Previous gen: gpt-4.1, gpt-4.1-nano, gpt-4.1-mini. Reasoning: o4-mini, o3-mini (no temperature support).
_comment_max_tokens: max_tokens: 0 = no limit (recommended for gpt-5/reasoning models). Set to a positive number (e.g., 1000) to limit API costs. Note: gpt-5 models use internal reasoning tokens, so they need higher limits than older models.
_comment_temperature: temperature: Only used for older models (gpt-4.x). GPT-5 and reasoning models (o1, o3, o4) ignore this setting.
_comment_reasoning_effort: reasoning_effort: Controls reasoning depth for o-series (o1/o3/o4) and gpt-5 models. Options: none (gpt-5.1+), low, medium, high, xhigh (gpt-5.2). Ignored for unsupported models.
